column1: # Authored expectation for the retained-storage test-surface join (owned by Phase 32).
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# independently authored expectation. Phase 32 had no authored expectation at all — the
# retired gate read a surface list out of a committed enumeration file and compared a
# committed ledger against a derived one. This file is the first authored opinion its gate
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   metrics  a value this run measured from its own evidence, compared against the authored
#            expectation in the gate's EXPECTED_RESULTS table
#   items    a committed seeded mutant, evidenced by that mutant going red for the exact
#            reason it was seeded to produce, never by the battery's total
#   checks   a gate side that either ran or did not
# The id-less surface is the one this register cannot decide: whether the Phase-37
# control-plane singleton carries no PVC is that phase's claim, not this one's.
